Good Shepherd Children’s Home (GSCH) is a ministry of Baptist Medical and Dental Mission International (BMDMI). GSCH is a home where abused, neglected, or abandoned children are living, learning, and growing in Christ. GSCH was founded in 1997 by BMDMI missionaries and is located on 70 acres of beautiful Honduran mountainside.
